title: rosa glauca var. intermedia
intro: Rosa glauca var. intermedia, commonly known as Intermediate Pink Dog Rose, is a variant of the Rosa glauca species, characterized by its unique pink-colored flowers. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa glauca var. intermedia are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit sedative effects. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
